en: A colorized photographic postcard depicting an Indigenous man identified as Chief Sitting Bull, Sioux. He wears traditional attire with intricate beadwork and braids, adorned with two feather plumes in his hair. The backdrop is plain, focusing attention on the subject. The corner contains printed text identifying him. The bottom edge gives credit to the photographer and the location (Omaha, Neb.), along with a copyright date.
